metadata.name: RNAFold Explorer simplified nearest-neighbour parameter set
metadata.units: kcal/mol (free energy change, delta G at 37 degrees C, 1 M NaCl)
metadata.description: A SUBSET of the Turner 2004 RNA nearest-neighbour parameters, used by a simplified Zuker-style energy model. Terms not listed here (terminal mismatches, dangling ends, special hairpin loops, 1x1/1x2/2x2 internal-loop tables, coaxial stacking, special GU contexts) are NOT modelled.

status_legend.published: Value transcribed from the cited Turner 2004 source.
status_legend.published_prediction_value: Turner 2004 lists a different measured value but recommends this value for structure prediction.
status_legend.approximate: Educational approximation chosen for this project; NOT a Turner 2004 value.

references: Xia T. et al. (1998) Biochemistry 37:14719-14735 (Watson-Crick stacking).
Mathews D.H. et al. (2004) PNAS 101:7287-7292 (Turner 2004 loop parameters).

stacking.description: Key 'XY/AB' means 5'-XY-3' paired with 3'-AB-5': outer pair X-A, inner (adjacent) pair Y-B. Symmetric equivalents are generated automatically by the loader.
stacking.source: NNDB Turner 2004 Watson-Crick helices (wc-parameters.html) and GU pairs (gu-parameters.html)
notes: GG/UU: measured +0.47 kcal/mol with a large error; Turner 2004 recommends -0.5 kcal/mol for structure prediction (status: published_prediction_value).
The special context 5'GGUC3'/3'CUGG5' (-4.12 kcal/mol for three stacks) is NOT modelled.

terminal_au_gu_penalty.description: Added for every A-U or G-U pair that ends a helix (exterior loop, multiloop, hairpin, bulges of 2 or more nt). Not added next to a 1-nt bulge (the stack continues) or inside internal loops (replaced by the internal-loop AU/GU closure term).
terminal_au_gu_penalty.source: NNDB Turner 2004 (per AU end / per GU end)

hairpin_initiation.description: Loop initiation by number of unpaired nucleotides. Minimum hairpin size is 3.
hairpin_initiation.source: Mathews et al. 2004 PNAS Table 1 (sizes 3-9); turner_2004_loop_dg.txt (sizes 10-30)

extrapolation.formula: dG(n) = dG(9) + 1.75 * R * T * ln(n / 9), used for n > 30

bulge_initiation.description: Bulge initiation by number of unpaired nucleotides. A 1-nt bulge also receives the stacking energy of its two closing pairs.
bulge_initiation.source: turner_2004_loop_dg.txt; equations from NNDB Turner 2004 bulge.html

extrapolation.formula: dG(n) = dG(6) + 1.75 * R * T * ln(n / 6), used for n > 30

not_modelled: RT ln(number of states) degeneracy term

internal_initiation.description: Generic internal-loop initiation by total number of unpaired nucleotides (both sides).

small_loops_approximation.note: Turner 2004 treats 1x1 (n=2) and 1x2 (n=3) internal loops with sequence-specific lookup tables that are not implemented here. As an educational approximation this project uses the n=4 initiation value (1.1) for these sizes.

extrapolation.formula: dG(n) = dG(6) + 1.08 * ln(n / 6), used for n > 30

internal_asymmetry_per_nt.description: Multiplied by |n1 - n2|, the difference between the unpaired nucleotides on the two sides of the loop.

internal_au_gu_closure.description: Added per A-U or G-U closing pair of an internal loop (replaces the terminal AU/GU penalty there).

multiloop.description: Linear multiloop model: dG = a + b * (unpaired nt in loop) + c * (number of helices, including the closing helix). Terminal AU/GU penalties are added for each helix end in the loop.
multiloop.note: Values of the classic linear multiloop model used in Zuker-style dynamic-programming programs. They could not be verified against the Turner 2004 NNDB pages for this project and are therefore treated as an educational approximation. (Turner 2004 uses a different, asymmetry-dependent multibranch model that is not implemented here.)

model_settings.note: Bulge and internal loops with more than 30 unpaired nucleotides are not considered by the dynamic programming (same bound as ViennaRNA's default). The energy evaluator can still score larger loops using the extrapolation formulas.
